title: Add explicit API route definitions and documentation
problem_statement: Static analysis found no HTTP route definitions; this limits understanding of service endpoints and hinders API modernization.
risk_if_unaddressed: API surface remains undocumented and untestable, increasing risk of breaking changes during modernization.
suggested_approach: Introduce FastAPI or equivalent route decorators with clear path and method definitions, add OpenAPI documentation.
success_criteria: All service endpoints have route decorators

provenance.evidence: No route decorators detected in static analysis

title: Implement secrets management using environment variables or vault
problem_statement: No evidence of secrets management; potential for credentials to be hardcoded or exposed.
risk_if_unaddressed: Security vulnerabilities due to leaked or hardcoded credentials.
suggested_approach: Refactor configuration to load secrets from environment variables or integrate with a secrets vault solution.
success_criteria: No hardcoded secrets in source code
Security audit passes for secrets handling

provenance.evidence: No vault or env var usage detected in static analysis

title: Increase unit test coverage and add integration tests
problem_statement: Test coverage is below recommended levels; missing integration tests for key modules.
risk_if_unaddressed: Higher risk of regressions and undetected bugs during modernization.
suggested_approach: Develop unit tests for all public functions and integration tests for inter-module workflows using pytest.
success_criteria: CI pipeline includes automated test runs
